candidate.description: BIPX locomotion and elemental milestone22:57UTC before independent sole-contact correction. Evaluate observed progress and known defects; NOT final release.

observations: Aldric retains sword only and Lyra rifle only. Current real UI/key input test covers eight1.8-second movement phases per class, including simultaneous attack; warrior produced zero player projectiles and one natural kill was visible in captured frame. This is bounded automation, not a human design review.

Base movement speed was changed from11 to6.5 world metres/second to better match the available Mixamo gait; max speed upgrade1.4 gives9.1. Natural pacing, balance against accelerating runners and sustained difficulty at the new speed have not yet been reviewed.
Foot dust is emitted at recorded contact anchors instead of a fixed0.2-second centre-of-character timer. Contact classifier is still imperfect as independent sole findings show.

Actual directional Mixamo clips were recovered from local assemblies. Lower-body continuous gait and upper-body attack/weapon preservation were added. Actual rendered world velocity is sampled after bounds and remote interpolation; teleport resets anchors.

All eight real keyboard phases per character passed the narrow controller diagnostics; source did not change during either run. Most selected toe-anchor plantedP95 drift was below0.00005m/s; Aldric diagonal reached0.1495539m/s, marginal against a predeclared0.15 threshold. This alone is NOT no-sliding proof.

Independent actual deformed foot-surface probes (>75%foot/toe weighting; same vertex within4cm of ground on adjacent support frames) contradict the tiny bone-marker drift: Aldric P90 surface drift0.333–0.889m/s; Lyra0.465–1.234m/s. Minimum soleY reached−0.0326m for Aldric and−0.1079m for Lyra. These defects are unresolved in this captured milestone.

Orc received distinct0.70-second Mixamo Run, preserved old GLB and six clips, no Walk overcranking as Run. A preliminary Orc contact solver also fixed only a selected marker; broader near-ground surface drift remains unresolved. Walker/Lich/Brute artistic rework and full remote contact review remain pending.

Root inspected four native game screenshots: models remain finite, swords/shield and rifle visible during forward/side/backward movement and attacks; these game-camera stills cannot certify subtle sole sliding or full deformation. Close playback review and true contact corrections are ongoing.

Subsequent source-stable close native fixture of this milestone exposed a severe Lyra waist/cloth stretch during moving rifle attack. Root directly compared dwarf-after-backward.png with the before image: torso remains at old world pose while pelvis advances, stretching connecting skin horizontally. The layering is REJECTED; preserving torso/hips and solving legs independently is now being developed. No native deformation approval.

Inspected actual1440x900 cemetery frames of both classes: teal night ground, stone paths, graves, warm lanterns and imported trees. Camera-corridor dither cutaway reveals player and selected nearby enemies through canopy. Weapon/character silhouettes remain visible in inspected stills.

Tree cutaway texture is visibly stippled; quiet-scene captures do not prove dense horde/mobile readability. Boss labels and mixed asset styles have not been given a complete perceptual review for this milestone.
Close native review exposes severe Lyra waist/cloth distortion during moving attack, not visible enough in the distant game stills. This candidate cannot be accepted visually.

Actual upstream MIT algorithms adapted from pinned HandCast3431252 and Linear8c377c8: faceted crystals/fracture/snowflake SDF, differential void halo, Voronoi toxic etching/bubbles, helical trail ribbons. Existing Samurai effects remain separately integrated. This is selective integration, not both full catalogues.

Preceding source-bound native BIPX integration22:54 passed three existing AI releases, trails and confirmed swept collision impacts, preserved sword/rifle triggers, high/medium/low forwarding and reduced motion. No browser or shader error. Targets were debug placed and health increased: diagnostic fixture, not natural spawning.

Root compared actual impact images and removed large legacy explosion spheres that obscured player and specific effects. First toxic ground stain was hidden by raised rune portal. A short hollow contact splash was then added; current22:56 native fixture compiles all shader branches cleanly, but its fresh in-game portal capture is still pending for this milestone.

Current isolated native VFX fixture has maximum3draws and bounded pools, resource geometry8before/8after200emissions/5afterdispose. CPU checks include identical50strip instances over16m at30/60/144fps. Isolated fixture is not game-performance evidence.

Authoritative network projectile trails are integrated; explicit network cast/impact events are absent. Snapshot expiry/removal does not fake a collision. Applicable-family coverage, dense combat and physical devices remain incomplete.

Keyboard movement and aimed attacks execute concurrently. Native screenshot shows an actual warrior kill; rifle shots and muzzle/trails visible. Sword remains exclusive to warrior. Target-aware natural60-second-perclass run at new speed remains pending; human feel, weight and fatigue are not established.

Both character choices were selected through actual menu controls and entered gameplay; HUD shows health,wave,XP,class weapon and keyboard hints. At1440x900 inspected frames show visible pause/audio buttons and scoreboard. Full current ranking/login/upgrades/death/restart and compact layouts have not been rerun for this milestone.
No physical iOS/Android current-candidate evidence. Desktop captures and quality-mode forwarding do not establish touch usability or phone frame time.
No current-candidate listening review or captured audio assessment. Existing audio runtime was not independently scored by this work.

Chrome WebGL2 ANGLE Metal AppleM5Pro used for native runs. Current isolated elemental fixture498frames,p95~16.8ms; this does not measure complete game performance. Added continuous pose drivers/contact correction need sustained natural game and dense horde measurement, especially mobile.

Root wired interpolated world velocity and yaw-before-pose ordering for remote character controllers. This change is source inspected only; new directional clips/contact changes have not been proven across two current browser clients. Network VFX impact authority is still missing.

The eight locomotion scenarios used real keyboard aimI/movementWASD/Space firing and stopped correctly. Elemental quality and reduced-motion state forward correctly; native low/reduced fixture retains identities and caps output. Full focus/contrast/zoom/noncolor verification and physical controls remain pending.

Current captured milestone has clean real browser logs for two classes and stable source hashes per movement run. Sampler collision/pause/teleport/recycling CPU test passed; actual enemy collision functions passed27checks. Those scoped checks do not establish all suites or long-run stability.

Failed directional animation fetch now drops rejected cache entry for recovery. More source changes are in progress after the milestone; this evaluation must stay bound to captured source, not automatically approve later iterations.
